Rooms.Name: At the Mouth of the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
As the brownish waters of the Xynarr River meet the crystal blue waters
of the vast ocean, they mix to form a cloudlike haze.  The mighty river
empties the debris and silt that it has carried from the north into the
ocean, thankful to be rid of its burden.  The river continues into a large
forest to the north, and to the south is an enormous ocean.  At the eastern
edge of the river's mouth is a peacful beach, created from the very debris 
left by the river.

Rooms.Name: At the Edge of the Xynarr River
Rooms.Description:
The mighty Xynarr River flows into the ocean just west of here.  Its
brownish waters churn as they reluctantly greet the warm blue waters of the
ocean.  A large forest extends to the north, but the density of the
underbrush makes it impossible to head in that direction.  A small beach
extends to the east and south, and the river lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Edge of the Forest
Rooms.Description:
A large forest of fragrant pine meets the edge of the peaceful beach.
The tall trees stand majestically, guarding their smaller brothers from the
onslaught of wind and salt from the ocean.  The dense underbrush that grows
between them makes it impossible to venture into the forest to the north,
but the beach continues in every other direction.

Rooms.Name: The Edge of the Forest
Rooms.Description:

The tall trees stand majestically, guarding their smaller brothers from the
onslaught of wind and salt from the ocean.  The dense underbrush that grows
between them makes it impossible to venture into the forest to the north,
but the beach continues to the west and south.

Rooms.Name: The Aquatic Meeting Place
Rooms.Description:
The hazy waters churn as the Xynarr River empties itself into the vast
ocean.  A small beach lies east of here, covered with debris from both the
river and ocean.  To the south the ocean extends as far as you can see.

Rooms.Name: A Peaceful Beach
Rooms.Description:
The sandy beach is covered with debris left from the last high tide.
Bits of driftwood and seaweed litter the sand, and create wonderful hiding
places for the tiny creatures that inhabit the beach.  A vast ocean extends
to the south for as far as you can see.  The beach continues to the east
and north, and to the west is a hazy mix of marine and fresh waters where
the Xynarr River meets the ocean.

Rooms.Name: In the Shallows
Rooms.Description:
The crystal blue waters have all but erased every trace of the large
river that flows into the ocean from the north.  The shallow waters
continue to the east and west, and the vast ocean continues for as far as
you can see to the south.

Rooms.Name: In the Shallows
Rooms.Description:
The shallow waters of the vast ocean are only waist deep here.  The 
gently rolling waves don't seem to be in any great hurry as they move past
you.  A peaceful beach is just north of here, and the ocean continues in   
every other direction.

The salty air and gently rolling waves of the ocean are making you just
a little seasick.  The ocean continues in every direction, but it appears
to become more shallow to the north.  In the distance you see a peaceful
beach, and beyond that a large forest.

Rooms.Name: On the Vast Ocean
Rooms.Description:
The salty air and gently rolling waves of the ocean are making you just
a little seasick.  The ocean continues in every direction for as far as you
can see, and not even a hint of land is anywhere to be found.  As you gaze
into the crystal blue waters, you can see that the ocean below you teems
with life.  Flashes of silver streak through the water, away from the
gaping mouths of unseen predators.  The vast ocean is a beautiful but
deadly place.

Rooms.Name: In the Shallows
Rooms.Description:
The shallow waters are only about waist deep on this part of the ocean.
The warm water feels quite soothing, and the gently rolling waves are
almost hypnotic.  To the south there is a sandy beach, but a terrible 
riptide makes passage in that direction very dangerous, if not impossible.

Rooms.Name: On a Sandy Beach
Rooms.Description:
The warm white sand of this beach has been meticulously groomed by the
forces of time and nature.  Waves gently lap at the edge of the beach as
they greet the land, only to be taken back out to sea by those behind them.
The vast waters of the ocean extend to the north for as far as you can see.
To the south is an tropical forest filled with all sorts of jungle life.

Rooms.Name: At the Edge of the Jungle
Rooms.Description:
As you near the edge of the jungle, the humidity nearly overwhelms your
senses.  The emerald curtain of trees hides a plethora of exotic life.  You
feel as if the eyes of the jungle are upon you as you near their tropical
home.

Rooms.Name: Caught in the Riptide
Rooms.Description:
As you struggle to break free from the riptide, you wish that you hadn't
attempted to pass through it!  You see a sandy beach to the south, but no
matter how hard you try to move towards it, the riptide insists upon
carrying you back out to sea.  You begin to grow quite tired from your
struggles.  You better think of a way out, fast!

Mobs.Name: whale shark ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: An enormous shark swims slowly beneath the surface of the water.
Mobs.Description:
The whale shark is monstrous in size, and you thank all that is good
that she doesn't care to eat anything larger than plankton.  Just
stay away from her enormous mouth, she could probably swallow you
whole!

Mobs.Name: shark great white ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: A large fin cuts through the surface of the water, heading your way!
Mobs.Description:
The great white shark has very sharp teeth, and extremely powerful
jaws.  He's an ancient predator, and he's maintained his place at the
top of the food chain because he is the perfect hunting machine.

Mobs.Name: whale blue ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: The blue whale rests at the surface as she pauses to feed her calf.
Mobs.Description:
The blue whale is the uncontested ruler of the ocean.  No predators
will even attempt to take this queen of the ocean into battle.  Her
sheer size alone is enough to ward off any potential enemies.  She is
fiercely protective of her calf, because while he is quite large
himself, he is still defenseless.

Mobs.Name: whale blue calf ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: A young blue whale calf nurses contentedly at his mother's side.
Mobs.Description:
While the young calf is enormous, he is still vulnerable to
predators.  He stays close to his mother's protective side, hoping
that he will be able to nurse uninterrupted.

Mobs.Name: turtle leatherback ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: Like a bird, the leatherback turtle flies slowly through the water.
Mobs.Description:
This enormous turtle relies heavily on a diet of jellyfish.  Her
enormous flippers are perfect for life in the water, and she uses
them to swim through the ocean in search of her prey.

Mobs.Name: lion sea sealion ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: A sea lion frolicks playfully in the waves.
Mobs.Description:
This sea lion loves to have his fun!  His sleek body and strong back
flippers are excellent for tearing through the water at incredible
speeds.  His front flippers act as a steering mechanism, allowing him
to make unbelievable mid-water turns.  Being the faborite snack of a
great white is dangerous, but life is good and there is fun to be
had!

Mobs.Name: manowar man-o-war ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: The float of an enormous man-o-war rides along on the current.
Mobs.Description:
The man-o-war appears to be a single animal, but it is actually made
up of hundreds, or even thousands, of smaller specialized animals.
Each member of this well-organized colony has its own purpose -
food gathering, reproduction, defense, or locomotion.  It's best to
steer clear of the long stinging tentacles of the man-o-war, they can
easily kill you!

Mobs.Name: jellyfish moon ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: A small jellyfish swims quickly through the ocean.
Mobs.Description:
The moon jellyfish is almost all jelly.  Its large bell is pushed
through the water by very short locomotive tentacles.  Those
tentacles can give a nasty sting to any would-be predators, but these
jellies are the favorite snack of the leatherback turtle!

Mobs.Name: cobia fish ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: A long, narrow fish swims past on his way to lunch.
Mobs.Description:
The cobia is a long narrow fish with a protruding lower jaw and a
depressed head.  He wears dark stripes along his silvery white body,
making him appear even longer than he is.  He is probably on his way
to find some tasty squid.

Mobs.Name: trout seatrout spotted fish ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: A spotted seatrout surfaces as she chases a tasty snack.
Mobs.Description:
The spotted seatrout has numerous distinct round spots on her back,
hence her name.  Her body is white on the bottom, and dark green on
the top.  She has a small set of canine teeth, which allow her to
grab hold of her tasty treats before they can escape.

Mobs.Name: palometa fish ocean
Mobs.LongDescription: A small, silvery palometa swims by quickly.
Mobs.Description:
The palometa is a strange-looking fish indeed.  His long dorsal and
anal fins and compact body make him a sight to behold.  He has a
silvery body with bluish edges, and four narrow black bars along each
side.
